test_title: PYST 11: SSC CGL - English (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

You could put your money to good use.

options.text: Your money is being put to good use.
Your money could have been put to good use.
Your money could be put to good use.
Your money has been put to good use.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Your money could be put to good use"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the active voice and we need to change this in the passive voice.
 
• The given sentence uses the past tense "could" and the object of the sentence is "your money" which will become the subject of the sentence.
 
• We need to use the following structure- Object (in active voice) + be + V₃ + Subject (in active voice)
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3 i.e. "Your money could be put to good use."**
